notes: The official location page and its own Order Online link resolve to the same Gallery Place restaurant at 707 7th Street NW, phone 202-349-3700.

Only this exact location's official tabs, PDFs, and linked Toast storefront were used for the current catalog. Menus from Chevy Chase, Willow Creek Farm, Georgetown, and Mark Center were not transferred.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.claim: Official Gallery Place menus state that care is taken to avoid cross-contact but the kitchen is not completely gluten-free. This is retained as a gluten-specific restaurant-level caution and is not generalized to every allergen or attached as a blanket item-level may-contain claim.
Official menus instruct guests to inform their server before ordering if they have a food allergy or dietary need.

evidence.excerpt: Official Gallery Place page confirms 707 7th Street NW, Washington DC 20001, phone 202-349-3700; exposes six current menu tabs and exact Toast order link; publishes ingredient descriptions, selected gluten-free labels, and a gluten-only cross-contact caution.

Official-linked Toast confirms Clyde's of Gallery Place at 707 7th Street NW and exposes 72 current prepared-food item links across starters, soups and salads, entrees, steaks, sandwiches, kids, and desserts; Wine Bottles was excluded.
Frozen baseline Gallery Place brunch document dated June 25; it is no longer linked and has been superseded by the current July 23 brunch PDF.
